name: KFC_Fast_Food_Applicaton
description: This project is a web-based platform inspired by the KFC website, offering users the convenience of ordering delicious fried chicken and other fast-food items. In this repository, we've developed a responsive and user-friendly website with functionalities such as menu checkout, account creation, cart management, and a secure payment process.

paragraphs: Welcome to the KFC Fast Food Application! This project is a web-based platform inspired by the KFC website, offering users the convenience of ordering delicious fried chicken and other fast-food items. In this repository, we've developed a responsive and user-friendly website with functionalities such as menu checkout, account creation, cart management, and a secure payment process.
features: Menu Checkout: Explore our menu of mouthwatering fast-food items and easily add them to your order.
Creating Account: Sign up to create an account, allowing you to save your order history, preferences, and delivery information.
Add to Cart: Select your desired items and add them to your cart for a quick and efficient ordering experience.
Payment Process: Experience a secure and hassle-free payment process to complete your order.
Responsive Design: Enjoy a consistent and user-friendly experience across various devices, including desktops, tablets, and mobile phones.
